document.description: Canonical source GLOBAL-WATER interaction alias. The current Shallow Ford appearance is a thin, shallow ribbon of cool water across the path, with the crossing floor readable beneath it. No invented current, treasure, stepping-stone puzzle, glass container or automatic drinking success. Origin at surface centre. Bounds are proposed for this ford only: other source uses of GLOBAL-WATER need their own reviewed appearance variants and must not inherit a ford in every room. Visibility and legal drinking/filling actions come from the engine, not the mesh.

materials.description: Low contrast blue-grey shallow water; no glow or written clues.
